description: List this workspace’s SAVED CREATORS — the reusable on-camera cast (AI creators made here, a person pulled from a social profile, a consented photo upload). Read-only, FREE. Each entry gives the name, the PORTRAIT URL, where the portrait came from and whether a real person’s likeness consent is on file, how many extra pose plates exist, and any chosen or cloned voice. That casts them for the whole spot (and skips the character-portrait render, so it costs less than not casting anyone). THE PORTRAIT URL IS THE REUSE HANDLE for the raw lanes. CALL THIS BEFORE OFFERING TO GENERATE A NEW PERSON: re-casting somebody the workspace already has keeps the SAME face across every ad, while a fresh person costs credits and breaks that continuity. An empty answer means the workspace genuinely has no cast yet.

gender.description: filter the PRESET creators by gender (the saved cast is never filtered)
